searchText: big endian specification for precompile input in this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7020, will make a corresponding PR to consensus specs to specify endianness of field elements >will make a corresponding PR to consensus specs to specify endianness of field elements Does this mean that all field elements will now be encoded in big endian format? I'm semi OOO so I missed the meeting yesterday I am trying to go through the specs to see what is what, but if the blob is also in big endian, i think everything naturally changes to big endian because of `bytes_to_bls_field` except kzgCommitment/kzgProof which are directly bls key bytes so essentially polynomial will be inverted if i just change ENDIANESS constant to bigendian? <dankrad> you can't change the ENDIANNESS constant as it has to be aligned with consensus specs aha its global, so i can make a new constant KZG_ENDIANNESS and update kzg ops <dankrad> but I am only just realizing the implications of this: the blobs will be distributed as little endian, and the precompile will be big endian. So the same data will now appear in both endiannesses 😩 <dankrad> this will cause a lot of confusion in the future well i have updated EIP to say blobs are bigendian <dankrad> as in the blob sidecar? <dankrad> that's also strange because it's CL? yes the blob vector is big endian, but for CL it doesn't matter because CL never interprets the blob vector it always uses underling kzg lib <dankrad> so is the idea now to make the whole KZG lib big endian? <dankrad> and change polynomial_commitments.md? yes, unless we just want verify_blob_.. interface inputs as big endian or have a separate `verify_kzg_proof_bigendian` wrapper if we have the wrapper, then everything can stay little endian including blob encoding, just that pre-compile input generation will be big endian <dankrad> my assumption on the ACDE was that this was only about the verify_kzg_proof function and that EL would just wrap this one function <dankrad> but this is a much bigger change if we want to change the library i am good with the fn wrap, can modify eip to reflect and add wrapper in polynomial_commitments.md <dankrad> honestly if we are planning to change blobs as well we *should* change the library <dankrad> cryptography libraries are big endian anyway sounds good will make this change <dankrad> are you going to do a PR on polynomial_commitments.md? yes here is the consensus PR: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3354 Is there an active dev discussion about the two finality issues from today and yesterday? This channel is quiet so I assume there are discussions elsewhere?

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: big endian specification for precompile input in this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7020, will make a corresponding PR to consensus specs to specify endianness of field elements

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content:
>will make a corresponding PR to consensus specs to specify endianness of field elements

Does this mean that all field elements will now be encoded in big endian format?

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content: I'm semi OOO so I missed the meeting yesterday

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: I am trying to go through the specs to see what is what, but if the blob is also in big endian, i think everything naturally changes to big endian because of `bytes_to_bls_field` except kzgCommitment/kzgProof which are directly bls key bytes

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: so essentially polynomial will be inverted if i just change ENDIANESS constant to bigendian?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> you can't change the ENDIANNESS constant as it has to be aligned with consensus specs

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: aha its global, so i can make a new constant KZG_ENDIANNESS and update kzg ops

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> but I am only just realizing the implications of this: the blobs will be distributed as little endian, and the precompile will be big endian. So the same data will now appear in both endiannesses 😩

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> this will cause a lot of confusion in the future

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: well i have updated EIP to say blobs are bigendian

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> as in the blob sidecar?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> that's also strange because it's CL?

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: yes the blob vector is big endian, but for CL it doesn't matter because CL never interprets the blob vector

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: it always uses underling kzg lib

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> so is the idea now to make the whole KZG lib big endian?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> and change polynomial_commitments.md?

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: yes, unless we just want verify_blob_.. interface inputs as big endian or have a separate `verify_kzg_proof_bigendian` wrapper

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: if we have the wrapper, then everything can stay little endian including blob encoding, just that pre-compile input generation will be big endian

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> my assumption on the ACDE was that this was only about the verify_kzg_proof function and that EL would just wrap this one function

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> but this is a much bigger change if we want to change the library

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: i am good with the fn wrap, can modify eip to reflect and add wrapper in polynomial_commitments.md

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> honestly if we are planning to change blobs as well we *should* change the library

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> cryptography libraries are big endian anyway

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: sounds good

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: will make this change
